_about: Copy to BOOK_DIR/verse_book.json. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Every key below is optional except 'chapters' (each with number and title); the values shown are the defaults unless the comment says 'example'.
_bank_id: example. Id of the bank; saved progress is stored under it, so do not change it later.
title: संस्कृत ग्रन्थ — भाग १
_title: example. The bank's 'book' field (shown as the book title).
_genre: example. Bank 'genre' (the template switches on Sanskrit-card settings for it).
summary: One or two English sentences about the whole book.
_labels: bank 'labels'. labels.unit also builds the concept 'unit' name: 'Chapter 3'.
_data_pattern: Verse file of chapter N, relative to the book dir ({N} = chapter 'number'). A chapter whose file is missing is skipped.
_authored_dir: Folder of the hand-written batch modules, relative to the book dir. It and the toolkit folder are put on sys.path, so a module can say: from helpers import mcq, match, order, fill, multi.
_ref_template: example. First sentence of the 'ref' block. Placeholders: {chapter} chapter number (Devanagari digits), {chapter_n} (plain), {kind} the unit kind label, {unit} unit number (Devanagari digits), {unit_n} (plain). Charaka: 'चरकसंहिता · सूत्रस्थान · अध्याय {chapter} · {kind} {unit}।'
source_disclaimer: पाठ: <स्रोत>। हिन्दी और English: AI-रचित, AI-समीक्षित; विद्वान् से जाँच शेष।
_source_disclaimer: example. Second sentence of the 'ref' block (source and the 'AI-written, not yet scholar-checked' statement). Empty = none.
_verse_block_labels: Label of the 'verse' block, by unit type.
_block_labels: Labels of the other blocks (keys of the card).
_digits: 'devanagari' (१२३) or 'latin' for unit numbers in titles and the closing ॥ n ॥.
_id_width: Concept ids are <prefix>-<unit number zero-padded to this width>; 66.1 becomes <prefix>-066-1.
_fold_english: English text (translation, glosses) is folded to plain Latin letters (ś -> sh, ā -> a). false keeps diacritics.
_max_chips_per_row: The template allows at most 30 word chips per row; longer rows are cut evenly.
_gram_overrides: example (default is {}). Replaces the Hindi grammar label of a chip, by its Devanagari form, when gram_hi.py's output is not right for that word.
_aid_labels: example (default is {}). Overrides the label of an aid kind; kinds: frame chain diagram letters seesaw story pegs puns anchors sandhi contrast chunks metre.
metre_text: हर पंक्ति में ८ + ८ अक्षर (गिनती से)। ‘|’ पाद की सीमा है; संधि के कारण वह शब्द के बीच भी पड़ सकती है।
_metre_text: Text of the computed metre aid.
_extra_bank_fields: Further top-level bank fields to add as they are.

chapters._number: Chapter number; also {N} in data_pattern and in the authored globs.
chapters.title: प्रथम अध्याय
chapters._title: bank 'unitTitle' of every concept of this chapter.
chapters._unit: Optional. The concept 'unit' name (default '<labels.unit> <number>'); also the key of unitSummaries.
chapters.summary: One English sentence: what this chapter covers (bank 'unitSummaries').
chapters._authored: Module files in authored_dir (a pattern or a list; {N} = chapter number). A pattern with a wildcard is subject to the BATCHES filter; a plain file name always loads. Modules load in this order, files sorted by name within a pattern (this fixes the rotation of mcq answer positions). Default is the pattern shown.
chapters._sections: Topic groups: inclusive [first, last, title] ranges over unit numbers ('66.1' sits between 66 and 67), or a string 'tools/authored/sections.py:RANGES' (file relative to the book dir, then the name of a list in it). Omitted = one section named like the chapter. Every unit must fall in a range.
chapters._metre: 'anustubh': verse units get a computed metre aid when every line has 16 aksharas (8+8). Anything else (e.g. 'upajati', 'none') adds no metre aid.
